authorization.currentDeliverable: User resumed preparation of an independent larger disposable linear-audio fixture. No package/install/system actions; D08/D09 not yet executed.

contextReadiness.workingCopyApproach: Already-open report-directory disposable fixture; separate exact saved baseline preserved. No reopen/save/project-content edits needed for initial report-only checks.

cases.action: Recheck branch/HEAD, seven source/stage hashes and receipt; identify current UDT path/load, exact host build/UXP/locale and disposable project. Capture fixture hash, clean/unsaved marker and relevant visible audio state before testing.
cases.acceptance: Explicit final-runtime binding and preservation baseline. Source/version strings alone are insufficient. Record fresh window identity; no project mutation or hidden setup.
limitations: Independent visible timeline state captured; mixer partly obscured by panel. Hash equality covers saved bytes, not every in-memory property.
Host UXP/locale strings are retained report metadata in the same session; executable file version read independently.

cases.action: Reuse the two preserved unchanged-project narrow/wide reports as repeat observations 1–2. If three repeats are required, add at most one read-only scan before deliberate fixture changes.
cases.acceptance: Full reports stable after excluding only generation time/duration; any other difference investigated. These repeats do not add detection cases or establish a same-layout performance benchmark.
limitations: Reuses two earlier 29 October layout reports and the reset scan; not a same-layout benchmark or additional detection cases.

cases.action: In the disposable project, physically select one finding's Reviewed/Intentional state; export JSON/HTML, then scan again.
cases.acceptance: Annotation changes only the report's review state, not findings/audio. Export pair contains that annotation; next scan resets annotations and selector to Unreviewed. Interaction is not evidence the finding was assessed as intentional.

operatorActions.independentReadback: First selector Reviewed; all seven exported annotations reviewed

limitations: User action is USER_STATED; UI/export values independently checked. Actual value was Reviewed for seven findings, not requested Intentional for one. Test annotations are not substantive assessments.
Original failed popup input preserved; recovery used operator selection. No product defect was established.

cases.action: Close and reopen only the plugin panel once in the same loaded UDT context, after an idle scan/annotation.
cases.acceptance: Report, annotation and controls remain consistent. Same-context report retention is expected; if the host recreates plugin context, record that separately and require honest empty state/disabled exports until a new scan. Context loss must not silently pass a retention assertion. No app quit or workspace reset.
limitations: Same loaded-context panel-only retention. No full app/project restart or fresh installed context. All seven annotations were not re-exported after reopen.
Panel reopened narrow at 326 x 359 versus prior 807 x 359; no size-retention assertion.
cases.dependencyMilestone: LQ-D02 annotated state established and exported; reset deliberately deferred until after D03 so nonempty annotation retention could be observed.

cases.action: Open one native export picker and Cancel, then export the retained report normally.
cases.acceptance: Cancel status, controls recovered, report retained, successful subsequent native export. Select the actual dialog, keep default filename/folder when focus is uncertain, verify actual file location. No rescan needed just to retry export.
limitations: Successful native picker cancellation/retry does not exercise a real plugin write failure; D05 remains NOT_RUN.

cases.action: Exercise an actual native write failure only with a harmless operator-approved unavailable destination already available; do not change ACLs/security or write into protected application folders.
cases.acceptance: A real plugin write rejection, visible error, recovered controls and successful subsequent export. A picker rejecting a path before plugin write is a different boundary. If a safe native write failure cannot be exercised, retain NOT_RUN and cite controlled coverage separately.

cases.action: With operator readiness, distinguish no active project from a successfully enumerated empty disposable project. Preserve/create separate fixture copies and media references deliberately.
cases.acceptance: No-project acquisition remains failed/UNKNOWN; zero-sequence successful enumeration may be COMPLETE with zero observed inventory. Neither may invent complete unknown denominators or routing/output certification. Preserve raw reports and independent project/sequence UI truth.
limitations: No-project failed acquisition is expected and distinct from empty-project COMPLETE enumeration. Neither establishes routing/output correctness.

cases.action: While idle, switch between two distinct disposable projects A/B; export retained A report before scanning B.
cases.acceptance: A's captured identity/evidence stays A until a new scan; new B scan identifies B. Record active UI identity and report identity separately. Do not edit or switch while a scan is active to claim an atomic snapshot guarantee.

actual.direction: Empty B captured -> populated A active -> retained B HTML exported -> new A scan

limitations: Direction reversed from populated-A to empty-B example to reuse the already captured B report; acceptance is captured-project identity retention across distinct idle projects.
Bounded idle project-switch evidence; no atomic snapshot claim during an active scan.

cases.action: Use an independently responsive larger disposable inventory, user-opened with desktop inspection idle during loading. Request Cancel during visibly active traversal, then retry once.
cases.acceptance: Retained visited evidence, explicit unvisited Unknowns, cancellation request/completion timestamps, progress/denominators, recovered controls and one successful retry. If the scan finishes before Cancel is exercised, record NOT_EXERCISED, not PASS; no fake host delays/setters or fault injection in the frozen runtime.

cases.action: Combine with D08's visibly active scan: observe disabled Scan/export controls and one deliberate second Scan input.
cases.acceptance: Bounded UI guard evidence during a real active traversal. One final report alone does not prove rejected overlap or adapter invocation count. If invocation count cannot be observed without altering runtime, state that limit; never claim instrumented single-flight proof.

cases.action: Prepare/save a separate working lifecycle copy, freeze its post-setup baseline, then normally close/reopen that copy after user readiness. Keep desktop inspection idle during loading; inspect after the operator reports it settled.
cases.acceptance: Saved copy/media resolution and relevant audio state persist, scan/export work after reopening, original canonical fixture untouched. Separate intentional Save/serialization changes from scan-only preservation; compare post-setup baseline and independent visible mute/Enable/settings/undo or clean-state evidence. File hash alone proves saved bytes, not all in-memory state.
limitations: Post-setup native Save intentionally changed only the disposable working file; canonical fixture remains unchanged.

Visible active-sequence mute/solo/record, pan/fader/Read and timeline/title indicators checked; every in-memory property, clip context Enable toggle/undo history and all settings were not independently inspected.
No media-relink dialog was observed; saved references and report inventory persisted. Playback/export audio correctness remains UNKNOWN.

cases.action: When packaging execution is authorized, UDT Package the exact frozen final stage into a new local CCX. Independently verify with `scripts/verify-package.ps1` and the final receipt; allow only documented manifest formatting.
cases.acceptance: Actual CCX path/SHA256, plugin ID/version and seven-file equality; no staging overwrite. Archive PASS remains separate from installation. A verified final CCX is a dependency for every installed-context case.

cases.action: User provides a designated clean test profile/host with normal Adobe access; record pre-install state and provenance.
cases.acceptance: Clean-context evidence, not merely an empty Creative Cloud acquired-plugin list or existing development profile. Never record credentials.

cases.action: Explicitly authorized normal Creative Cloud installation of K01's exact CCX; user handles UAC/authentication. Verify installed contents and inactive developer registrations.
cases.acceptance: Installer outcome, selected package/hash, installed path/ID/version, six exact runtime files plus manifest values as appropriate. No UDT fallback/installed-predecessor substitution.

cases.action: After readiness/authorization, normal Premiere restart with UDT not launched; open installed panel, scan disposable project and export both reports; exercise the relevant panel/review/cancel recovery checks in installed context.
cases.acceptance: Fresh installed binding, host startup/menu/panel evidence and actual lifecycle results. Developer-context evidence may guide expectations but cannot replace installed execution. No forced quit or unsaved work discard.

cases.action: Separately authorized upgrade from an authentic, verified lower-version same-ID package. First establish that installed baseline, then install final 0.2.1 normally.
cases.acceptance: Genuine prior artifact/provenance, version transition and before/after installed identities with working panel/report. Same-version predecessor 0.2.1 replacement is not automatically an eligible upgrade. If no eligible prior package exists, keep NOT_RUN; do not relabel binaries/versions.

cases.action: Separately authorized normal uninstall in the test profile, after preservation/readiness.
cases.acceptance: Native removal result and absence of installed panel/files under the documented normal flow. Preserve exports and user projects; deletion is an operator-confirmed consequential action.

cases.action: Separately authorized reinstall of the exact K01 candidate, followed by a normal restart/scan/export smoke.
cases.acceptance: Correct installed identity restored and bounded installed smoke passes. Reinstallation must not inherit PASS solely from I02.
